evidenceBoundary: Every entry is limited to behavior already established from the decoded 1ST_READ executable and exact room-script traces.
A semantic name does not imply that every argument or suboperation is understood.
Mode- or suboperation-specific behavior remains explicitly bounded; unknown variants must stay numeric.

Reads the exact seven-byte r14-relative frame or r9-relative scene source, normalizes its native calendar fields, recomputes Sunday-zero weekday, and installs the result at fixed native clock record 0x0c225228.

Resolves an object and its exact FACE-tagged associated record, writes mode byte 0x82, the low word of argument three, a zero secondary word, and the three-float request vector addressed by argument two.

Subtracts argument zero's three-float vector from argument four's vector, rejects magnitudes greater than the float32 argument-one threshold, computes the native low-16-bit binary heading from delta X/Z, and returns one only when the absolute wrapped difference from argument two is strictly less than signed argument three.

Writes argument zero unchanged to the fixed SCRL renderer control dword at 0x0c1f7128.

Resolves an object, obtains one of its native three-component vectors, conditionally replaces or adds selected components from a supplied vector, and writes the result back through the matching direct or associated-object path; flag mask 0x04200000 selects a separate angular computation.

Resolves argument zero, reads its direct position, computes the native binary heading from that position toward argument two's world point, and replaces all three direct secondary-vector components with [0, heading, 0] through the shared operation-0x001d reconciliation path.

Mode eleven copies arguments two through four to record dwords +0xa0 through +0xa8 and sets flag 0x04000000.

Returns one exactly when the resolved object has a literal XMPT record, XMPT +0x18 is nonzero, and XMPT +0x1c equals five; otherwise returns zero.

Forwards its first argument unchanged to the shared camera-state mode selector, which records the requested mode and performs the native mode transition.
Returns the unchanged dword at fixed address 0x0c20c3e0 through the dispatcher's operation-result slot. The fixed global's producer, lifecycle ownership, and gameplay name remain unknown.

Argument two is forwarded but unused.

Mode 6 multiplies the shared native unit-range random result by argument one, truncates it to an integer, and returns a value in [0, bound).

Values 0 through 69 stop any current activity, select that exact installed operation-0x013e slot, initialize its ASEQ/ACAM/AMOV/ASTR/ALIP activity, and set the native active state byte to one. The browser runtime requires an exact installed resource and bounded presentation adapter.
A runtime slot is accepted only when its signed value is in 0 through 69; the same exact installed-resource and bounded activity-start contract then applies. Other runtime values fail closed.

Starts reset it to zero, ordinary terminal cleanup preserves zero, and only expiry of the distinct offset-0x38 delayed-stop countdown sets it to one. D000 selector 18 compares the result with zero after its DRAUTH activity completes.

Mode minus nine dispatches directly to the common return without reading either trailing argument or mutating activity state. It is an exact native no-op for every three-argument call shape.
Mode minus six runs the native pre-stop and terminal-stop sequence for the current activity. With no active activity the operation completes without a state mutation.

Dispatches the native free-conversation manager. It loads and selects authored room-person records, exposes current-person and manager state, drives reset/availability paths, and forwards suboperations 11/12, 13/14, and 15/16 to auxiliary state banks 2, 3, and 4 respectively. Higher-level meanings of numeric person fields, property selectors, and state-bank indices remain unresolved.

Selector zero preserves the fixed byte at 0x0c201c40 and sets mask 0x40; selector one preserves it and clears mask 0x40. The executable image initializes the byte to zero. Other selectors remain unresolved.

Resolves argument zero and selects its literal HNDL record for a zero argument one or HNDR otherwise. A present record clears 71 vector slots starting at +0x4c, installs 19 vectors from argument two at the executable-fixed indices, sets record byte +0x49 to one, and stores argument three's signed low word clamped to at least one at +0x4a.
Selector 2 reads the persistent yen balance. The capsule-toy debit, vending affordability, and MONEY_LOCK paths independently identify this selector as currency measured in JPY.
Selector 2 replaces the persistent yen balance with argument one. Native capsule-toy and vending paths compute their debit or refund before issuing this write.

Resets all 128 indexed controller records to the native initialized defaults, installs authored global mode 1 or 2, and crosses the native presentation callback with argument zero for mode 1 or one for mode 2. Mode 1 additionally activates record zero. The callback must succeed before state is committed.
Copies four exact authored float words to the fixed indexed-controller presentation vector and crosses the native presentation callback. The callback must succeed before state is committed.

Initializes the indexed controller record, writes mode 3 to +0x04, copies three exact authored float words to +0x28 through +0x30, and activates it. Indices below 32 cross the native mirror/presentation callbacks before state is committed.

Selector 2 copies four raw float words from the exact frame-address or static-pointer source to record offsets +0x08 through +0x14, except source components one through three compare against native epsilon word 0x3727c5ac and become zero when the epsilon is greater. Selector 5 clamps the constant or frame-field raw float word at +0x1c to minimum word 0x3c23d70b, reclamps the existing +0x20 to that minimum, mirrors both below index 32, invokes the +0x1c callback, then invokes the product callback with float32(+0x1c * +0x20).

Selector 8 copies three exact float words from the frame-address or static-pointer source to record offsets +0x34 through +0x3c. Indices below 32 mirror all three words and invoke the native presentation callback with the sign of every component inverted.

Forwards native arguments zero, one, and two unchanged to the shared sound-command dispatcher at 0x0c17a91c and returns its result. Individual bank and command meanings remain numeric unless separately evidenced.

Resolves an actor and dispatches the exact authored MHND routes. Selector -1 installs state 14 and timing pointer 0x0c288380 in both scheduler records. Numeric channels 0, 1, and 2 configure the first, second, or both timed subcontrollers from the exact runtime source snapshots and static target row. The two authored duration-one direct-action calls remain explicit runtime stops.

The adjacent native consumer reads +0x09 unsigned and uses it as a dword-table selection index from IMGM +0x04.

A nonzero argument one preserves the exact identity capture, preparation, current-owner +0x1c resolution, four-argument application, gate, conditional identity reconciliation, and two-stage finalization sequence. All ten subordinate boundaries remain mandatory low-level adapters; descriptor and subsystem meanings remain unknown.
Sets the integer state of one of the native 32 numbered MAP-layer resource records. Individual non-Boolean state meanings remain unlabelled.
Reads or writes byte, word, dword, or float elements selected by the native descriptor's base, type, and index fields.

Forwards the sole authored word unchanged to the exact native registry-release helper. A null or absent record is an ordinary zero-result no-op; a matching record is unlinked, releases its owned native state, and returns one. No authored call consumes the result.

Resolves argument zero as an actor. A present MOTM controller receives argument one's low word at offset +0x7c. A missing actor is a no-op; a resolved actor without MOTM is passed to the exact current-scene registry unlink routine.

Resolves argument zero as an actor and its MOTM controller. Modes 0, 1, 2, and 3 set controller flag 0x4000 and write 3, 7, 0, or 5 to dword +0x1cc. Mode 0xffffffff clears flag 0x4000 and zeroes dword +0x1cc plus words +0x86, +0x90, and +0x9a. A missing actor is a no-op; a resolved actor without MOTM follows the exact current-scene registry unlink path.
